YOUR COMFORT IS OUR PRIORITY
Learn More About Us
PROVIDING QUALITY HVAC SERVICES FOR MORE THAN 25 YEARS

We offer the highest level of home comfort services throughout Bergen, Passaic, Hudson, Essex, Morris, and Union counties. We provide HVAC repair, maintenance, and installation services to residential and commercial customers across the region.

​

Whether you have central air, a furnace, boiler, ductless mini-split, or hydronic heating and cooling system, our skilled technicians have the expertise and experience to get the job done right the first time. We use industry-standard tools and quality materials to service your equipment promptly and effectively.

​

We also offer top-quality HVAC maintenance plans to ensure trouble-free operation of your heating, cooling, and ventilation equipment for years to come.

​

If there's anything else we can do to make your experience better, just ask. We look forward to earning your business.

Keep cool with our expert AC repair services! We specialize in diagnosing and fixing all types of air conditioning issues promptly and efficiently. Whether it's a minor repair or a major overhaul, our team of skilled technicians is dedicated to restoring your AC unit to peak performance.

Heater Repairs

Stay warm and cozy all winter long with our expert heater repair services! When your heating system falters, our team of skilled technicians is here to diagnose and fix the issue quickly and effectively. Whether it's a malfunctioning furnace, a faulty thermostat, or any other heating problem, we have the expertise and tools to get your system back up and running smoothly.

Visit Page
PEEK AT WHAT OUR CUSTOMERS THINK!
OUR PROJECTS

We specialize in delivering unparalleled commercial HVAC solutions for large-scale commercial buildings and high-rise apartment complexes. With expertise honed through years of experience, Yuhan Heating & Cooling stands as a leading commercial HVAC contractor, committed to providing advanced heating, ventilation, and air conditioning services tailored to meet the unique demands of large-scale properties.

We understand the intricate complexities of managing commercial HVAC systems for large-scale projects. From initial design and installation to ongoing maintenance and system optimization, our team of experienced HVAC professionals is dedicated to ensuring optimal comfort, energy efficiency, and indoor air quality throughout every inch of your commercial building or high-rise property.

PROMOTIONS & PROGRAMS

Throughout the years, we've had the opportunity to work on a variety of HVAC projects, providing heating and cooling services for various property types ranging from small single-family homes to towering corporate office buildings. From routine HVAC maintenance to large-scale industrial equipment replacement, our work on these projects reflects our commitment to ensuring all your heating and cooling needs are met, whether it's for a neighborhood home next door or an entire apartment building complex.

​

Explore our HVAC project portfolio to discover how we've transformed spaces into havens of comfort and efficiency. From multi-unit residential high-rises to large-scale commercial HVAC projects, we've leveraged our knowledge and experience to provide tailored HVAC solutions that meet our clients' unique needs.
